g.text: Measured computational cost, not an iteration-count proxy
Top: actual calls used, with descriptive SD across trials. Bottom: each point averages all graph/start trials at one depth; larger dots mean deeper circuits.
Sampled modes spend 2,048 shots per training call. Costs exclude final evaluation. Ideal calls still cost CPU time despite using zero measurement shots.
